mathematical_formulas.gpr_parameter_risk: r_max = max(upper_95 / max_limit, upper_slope / max_slope_per_hour); r_max > 0.70 ? min(100.0, max(0.0, (r_max - 0.70) * 250.0)) : 0.0

disposition_synthesis_precedence.condition: ml_probability >= 0.65 OR anomaly_status == 'REJECT' OR safety_exceeded == true
ml_probability >= 0.20 OR anomaly_status == 'MONITOR' OR safety_warning == true OR prognostic_status == 'INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY'

override_reasons.ML_HIGH_RISK: Calibrated ML failure probability exceeds high-risk threshold (P >= 0.65).
override_reasons.PAT_CRITICAL_ANOMALY: Part Average Testing (PAT MAD) detected critical parameter anomaly.
override_reasons.COPOD_CRITICAL_ANOMALY: COPOD empirical copula multivariate tail probability anomaly.
override_reasons.GPR_IDDQ_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Gaussian Process Regression predicts IDDQ safety slope/limit breach within 168h.
override_reasons.GPR_ILEAK_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Gaussian Process Regression predicts Ileak safety slope/limit breach within 168h.
override_reasons.GPR_TPD_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Gaussian Process Regression predicts Tpd safety slope/limit breach within 168h.
override_reasons.ML_ELEVATED_RISK: Calibrated ML failure probability exceeds operating threshold (P >= 0.20).
override_reasons.ANOMALY_OR_DRIFT_WARNING: Elevated statistical anomaly or degradation drift warning.

disclaimers.evaluation_only: This contract formalizes multi-criteria risk fusion for benchmark evaluation and disposition synthesis. It does not replace human quality assurance.
